investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Riverwave Retail (online retail); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.126.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster riverw-prod-cacent (EKS); Database: mysql server payments-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-807d857c70aef4090; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
